title: Three and a half years in the Navy band
summary: Breaux says he was in the Navy for three and a half years in a band with Bill Humphrey and Clyde Kerr.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Were you in the service? Did you get the Gihan Bell for doing that?
I was in the Navy for three and a half years. I was in the Sam band with Bill Humphrey and Clark Kerr, Magnus Kruster, we all was in the Sam Navy band together.
